notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618733/ecad67c64f27e1176f389d7a0b6b55eb64b935ba.png[/img]

Dear Dean,

To enhance your gaming experience, the Logistics Department plans to perform server maintenance starting at 04:00 on December 11th, with an estimated maintenance duration of 1 hour.
During the server downtime, some areas of the welfare institute will be temporarily closed for the inspection and repair of the stability anchors. We kindly ask you to arrange your schedule in advance to avoid unnecessary disruptions.
Once the maintenance is completed and the welfare institute reopens, the update supplies will be sent to your office mailbox. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

【Update Content】

I. New Features and Optimizations:
1. Model replacement for "Suloh-WhaleΩ," "Suloh-LeechΩ," and "Suloh-TapirΩ."
2. Leader "Saki" is now available in the Telescope Shop, where the Dean can exchange using "Rainbow Telescopes."

II. Balance Adjustments:
1. We have identified three issues with the current Leader "Dean":
   (1) The Welfare Institute's Dean starts with 3 energy points, making some energy-utilizing hybrid decks too powerful.
   (2) The Foundation's Dean's 0-cost mechanical cards, when combined with C4, can gain an overwhelming advantage in the early game, making it difficult for opponents to counter.
   (3) For new players, the 3-energy Dean is significantly different from the Dean experienced in the tutorial, which can cause confusion.
   Therefore, we have made preliminary adjustments to the Dean, reducing the energy cap while granting the skill "Lantern of Hope" (0-3, active use grants 1 energy point), which serves as a hybrid entity, a shield against opponents, and an energy generator.
   We aim to maintain the energy acquisition of the Foundation's Dean while ensuring strong early-game defensive energy and catering to the early activation of hybrid decks.
2. The "Devouring Mouth" obtained from "Saki's" skill "Affectionate Splash" is changed to: deal 2 damage to a chosen subordinate on the field.
   The reason for the adjustment: We believe "Saki" is generally balanced, but the passive of its second branch, when combined with Saki's subordinates, completely positiveizes the negative effects of the leader skill, so we slightly reduced the benefits of the second branch to balance the leader's cooperation with the subordinates.
3. "Gordon's" skill "Contra Destiny" is changed to: (Cooldown 7) (Energy 7) Deal 7 mental damage to the enemy leader, and if you have 7 Gatherers' marks, consume all to deal an additional 7 damage.
   The reason for the adjustment: "Gordon's" first branch is indeed too weak currently, and it lacks the sense of accumulating power for a final burst that we initially designed, so we increased the benefits of the final skill of the first branch to match the rhythm lost in the early game.
4. "Amy's" skill "Infinite Damage Increase" is changed to: (Energy 4) Grants the passive "Damage Increase X: Additional X damage from subordinates' attacks (X is the number of damage mark layers)" to your leader.
   The reason for the adjustment: The usage rate of "Amy's" second branch skill "Ultimate Skill" is low, so we slightly reduced its cost, hoping more players will use it.
5. "C4's" skill "Self-Destructive Transmission" is changed to: (Cost 1): Reconstruct 3, choose between "LIGHTING Reconnaissance Type" / "Type-C High Energy Type" / "M-USB Universal Type" and summon one of your chosen subordinates on the spot.
   "C4's" health is changed to 2.
   The reason for the adjustment: For C4, we found two issues:
   (1) The original SamsaraC4 appears every turn, and with powerful field-laying decks, its staying power is too strong, so we slightly reduced the health of the original C4 to make it easier for players to deal with.
   (2) The "Fantasy Skill - Self-Destructive Transmission" is too versatile, especially with cost reduction, it can achieve an almost unbeatable combo, so we adjusted the cost of this skill.
6. "Gatherer's" skill "Go Down Together" is changed to: This subordinate will destroy itself upon deployment; then deal 8 damage to the subordinate in front.
   The reason for the adjustment: We adjusted this skill's value to be closer to the template, and we understand that the Foundation currently has difficulty dealing with high-value hybrid subordinates, hoping this adjustment can curb the problem of high-value hybrid subordinates (such as Saki, Mourning Bitterness, Phantom Love) staying in the field.
   The snow dust obtained from the disassembly of the above subordinates will be the same as the synthesis cost within a month, and we will continue to pay attention to the balance of the Dean and other cards and adjust in a timely manner.

III. Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed the issue where "Grey Cluster Node - Crimson" skill "Assimilation Terminal II" did not take effect.

Due to the adjustments of the Leader "Dean" and the bug fixes, we have prepared 1 "Blank Invitation Ω" and 20 "New Performance Tickets" for everyone. We will continue to pay attention to the game's balance and bugs, and if the Dean encounters any problems, please contact us for feedback.

2. Newcomer 7-Day Missions: Guidance for seven-day missions, completing each task not only allows you to quickly get started with the game but also to receive generous rewards, as well as the welfare institute's exclusive leader - You.

5. Dessert Points Shop: During the event period, players can accumulate recharge volume and receive additional recharge rewards at the Dessert Points Shop when reaching a certain amount. It includes the precious Omega-level subordinate "Bloom in the Mirror."

In addition, we have prepared a large number of compensations and return gifts for the old deans, hoping to make everyone's journey back to the Snow Realm smooth.

1. Recharge Rebate: All old deans will receive information rebates according to the paid test player rebate rules.

Rebate Rules:
The total amount spent in the game will be refunded at a rate of 1 yuan = 10 information units during the public test. If there is a decimal after calculation, it will be rounded up.
Rebate example:
■ Players who have recharged a total of ≤ 648 yuan will receive a 255% information rebate.
■ Players who have recharged more than 648 yuan will receive a 255% information rebate for the part up to 648 yuan, and a 150% information rebate for the amount exceeding 648 yuan, with no upper limit.
■ Example: A player who has recharged a total of 1000 yuan can receive a total information rebate of:
(648×10×255%) + [(1000-648)×10×150%] = 21804 information units

2. Subordinate Gift: For all deans who have reached a rank of 1600 points in the Ignition League or have passed all PVE levels, we will give each dean one card of all subordinates. (Excluding Ouroboros and variant cards)

3. Resource Gift: For the old deans who meet condition 2, we will give gifts including the avatar "Pioneer," film "Plum Scent Reflects on Beauty," dean portrait "Researcher," 2000 Lucky Coins, and 4 Exploration Permits (The dean portrait will be available for collection in the upcoming version update, please pay attention to the announcement).

This journey into the Snow Realm has reached its starting point. We are here waiting for your arrival, waiting for you to grow here, and to guide the way forward.
In this special Snow Realm, think, teach, listen, and convey.
On this long journey, we ascend step by step.

notes.title: "Snow Reach" Steam Version Consolidation and Restart Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618733/650a8fcdd0328ed6e8a4ac87f881c78e90fac5db.png[/img]

Dear Deans,

We are extremely grateful for your unwavering support for  The Snow  . Since the game's launch, we have received enthusiastic feedback and valuable suggestions from many deans, and it is your support that propels us forward.

As the   Logistics Department of Welfare Home  , with a sense of regret, we announce to everyone: In order to integrate versions and coordinate with the national region launch,  The Snow  will temporarily be taken off the Steam platform and will be relaunched simultaneously when it goes live in the national region.

The specific downtime will be from November 18th to December 5th.

I. Why is the shutdown and restart necessary?
1. As the version development progresses, we have realized that the existing version has many technical shortcomings, including but not limited to performance optimization, stability enhancement, and cross-server matching. The synchronization issues that deans often encounter are due to the underlying code. Without spending a week for large-scale adjustments, it is difficult to perfectly resolve these issues. Therefore, to provide deans with a smoother and more stable gaming experience, we need to carry out comprehensive technical upgrades and updates to the game.
2. Another core purpose is to keep in sync with the domestic version, including cross-server matching battles. We have tried other methods such as match ban cards or self-selected server matching, but none of them can perfectly solve the cross-server matching issue. So, to ensure that all players can match with each other and play together, maintaining version consistency is the best method.
3. Lastly, the launch of the   Ouroboros  faction was somewhat hasty. We had prepared related stories and activities for it, but at that time, for testing purposes, we released it ahead of schedule on the Steam version. After this restart, deans will also be able to follow the version and experience the complete story and activity experience.

    Although it is a short-term downtime, we understand that it will still cause many inconveniences to the deans. Here, we extend our apologies to all deans affected by this, and we have prepared many compensations. With some lessons from previous games, we will definitely satisfy the deans in terms of compensation.

II. Our Compensation:
1. Refund for paid players: We promise to retain the payment records of the deans and return the pheromones according to the rebate rules for paid test players for all paid players.
2. Subordinate compensation: For all deans who have reached the 1600-point Flame segment, we will gift each dean one of each   Same-name Subordinate  card after the restart (excluding  Ouroboros  and alternate art cards).
3. Additionally, each veteran dean can join the QQ group (724953283), take a screenshot of their account and register with the administrator @Xuefeng, and we will prepare a physical peripheral gift for you.

We hope to compensate for the inconvenience to the deans during the game's downtime as much as possible and express our gratitude to the dean community.

In conclusion, we once again extend our most sincere apologies to all deans affected by the game's downtime. Thank you for your continuous companionship and support. Once the game is adjusted, we will relaunch it as soon as possible, bringing a better gaming product and a more comfortable experience to the deans.

We look forward to embarking on the snowy realm together with all the deans once again.

notes.title: Title: Announcement on the Handling of Score Manipulation in "Ranking Mode"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618733/ecad67c64f27e1176f389d7a0b6b55eb64b935ba.png[/img]

Dear Directors：

We have recently received feedback from some directors regarding the issue of score manipulation in "Ranking Mode." After data verification, it has been confirmed that there are indeed instances of abnormal scores among some directors, which seriously affects the principles of fairness and the competitive experience of the directors.

In order to protect the interests of the directors and to create a fair gaming environment, the Welfare Home has analyzed and discussed and has formulated the following handling plan:

1. We will deal with the users who have manipulated scores in the near future, which may include but is not limited to deducting materials obtained through abnormal scores.
2. After this week's update, a limited edition avatar titled "Fairness" will be gifted to all directors. We hope everyone can work together to maintain competitive balance.
3. We will continue to increase technical investment in the "Combat Mode" to ensure that directors can match suitable opponents to hone their skills and climb the ranking ladder.

We are well aware that there are still issues in the game that affect the directors' experience. Our team will earnestly listen to feedback and suggestions, continue to organize and resolve these issues, and strive to polish "The Snow Reach" to be even better. Once again, we thank the directors for their tolerance.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618733/2afc92fbc26a0f491de33290aa4fef440c5d014a.png[/img]


Hello everyone~ This is the Wish Team, who stays up late every night fixing bugs.
With the update of the version, we have received a variety of feedback from players. This not only motivates us but also gives us the opportunity to face more players. After the initial stable version, we have organized the feedback that is currently more common and made an update preview to tell everyone our main update direction.
Firstly, for the optimization part, we will focus on the following three main update directions: [Subordinate Passive Brief Display], [Combat Animation Rhythm Optimization], and [Advanced AI].
[h2][b]Subordinate Passive Brief Display[/b][/h2]
We have found that many subordinate passives such as "Prohibit Attack," "Cannot Be Targeted by Skills," "Flight," "Flight Block," and various other effects are not clearly recognized by players. Although we have made special effects to distinguish them, the overall visibility is still not prominent enough. We will display them more intuitively next to the subordinates in the form of text information + TIPS.
[h2][b]Combat Rhythm Animation[/b][/h2]
Currently, in the game, there are situations where the death of subordinates and their attacks are sluggish and slow. We will carefully adjust the transitions between them, add impact effects such as vibrations, remove useless animations, and strive to achieve the sense of impact and smoothness similar to ARPG games.
[h2][b]Advanced AI[/b][/h2]
We have found that the number of people in the game is still relatively small, so we plan to add advanced AI that is as realistic as real people in the story or in the new competitive arena, striving to ensure that everyone has cards to play and battles with various interesting opponents.
After we address these three key optimization areas, we will focus on [Main Storyline Guidance Optimization], [Reset the Flesh Dove Mode], [Add New Entertainment Modes], and [Add New Subordinates and Factions].
[h2][b]Main Storyline Guidance[/b][/h2]
Currently, the difficulty of the main storyline still fluctuates greatly, and many passives and skills are not clearly explained in the main storyline tutorial. In addition to adjusting the novice storyline level by level, we will also add a [Help Dictionary] to the game and add some tutorial levels to help new players get started better.
[h2][b]Reset the Flesh Dove[/b][/h2]
At present, the Flesh Dove in the game is still a relatively basic gameplay. We plan to join a shop and currency, like other games with rich Flesh Dove experiences, add difficulty options for players to choose from outside, and add a new relic unlock in the atlas, new Flesh Dove exclusive subordinates. At the same time, there will also be a very new and strange [Unknown Chromatic Object] atlas unlock system. With the use of certain [Unknown Chromatic Objects], players will gradually understand their abilities.
[h2][b]Add New Entertainment Modes[/b][/h2]
We will also develop new entertainment modes such as double selection, contests, and battle chess. Some of these are already in the planning and production stages, while others are still in the planning phase.
[h2][b]Add New Subordinates and Factions[/b][/h2]
As previously announced, we will add two new factions, [Ouroboros] and [Indigenous], and update the corresponding exclusive subordinates for each faction. Each of our factions has a completely different cost system and gameplay, so everyone can look forward to it.

Team LastWish

notes.title: CODE:LIMBUS" January 11th Update Content
notes.content:
New Features and Optimizations:

Improved beginner's guide with added tutorials for some features.
Upgrading can now be done using the corresponding negatives or by consuming "Snow Dust."
Extra "Heart Voices" will be converted to "Heart Scraps," which can also be used for unlocking custom skills.
Different types of "Snow Dust" (Γ, B, A, Ω) will be unified into one "Snow Dust." Directors can go to "Decomposition Mode" (Backpack - Negatives - Decomposition Mode) to convert their existing Snow Dust into the unified form.
Added a feedback section on the main interface. Directors can click to submit issues or directly join the QQ group: 724953283, to contact administrators.
The mechanism for obtaining leaders has changed. Directors can now directly use "Pheromones" or "Lucky Coins" to purchase their desired leaders.
Difficulty of exploration stage 1-5-3 has been lowered.
New side mission 1 [Blue Flame Arsenic Poison] added.
Skill and Value Adjustments:

Prism - Slow Reflection: Changed from 2 energy + 1 pheromone 3/3 to 2 energy + 1 pheromone 1/3.
Prism - Anomalous Light: Changed from 3 energy + 1 pheromone 1/4 to 3 energy + 1 pheromone 1/2.
Decomposition of the above cards now yields 160 "Snow Dust."
Adjustment Explanation: We've noticed that the Prism deck is very strong in the early, mid, and late game. The early second-turn Slow Reflection 3/3 self-destruct was too oppressive, and its late-game offense and defense were also formidable. We aim to slightly reduce the power of Slow Reflection and the health of Anomalous Light to delay the Prism deck's strong phase without affecting its late-game strength.

Fixed an issue where the background music might be missing when initially entering the game.
Fixed an incorrect progress display issue in the loading screen of the Deep Dispatch Investigation.
Fixed an issue where text was obscured when there were too many options in a random event during the Deep Dispatch Investigation.
Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if a battle was lost due to the activation of the terminal device in 1-5-3 and then attempted again.
